bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to A4 size are allowed; bags larger than A4 and backpacks are not. Event organisers can tighten these rules.
allowed: Bags of A4 size or smaller
bagPolicy.note: Paid drop-off points for larger and prohibited items are located outside the arena.

parking.summary: The Messe Zürich garage has about 2,000 spaces and is around two minutes on foot from the hall.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general rideshare pickup location for concerts; consult the event instructions.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The visitor guide lists food and drink services and provides paid lockers, including small-bag size L for CHF 6.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Both main entrances have separate access for wheelchair users and guests with limited mobility. Wheelchair spaces, with room for a companion, are on the southeast and southwest sides, and accessible toilets are nearby. Book wheelchair tickets through the event organiser; Ticketcorner (+41 44 316 77 88) can tell you whom to contact.

reEntry.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general concert re-entry rule for concerts; consult the event instructions.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets through the event page on the Hallenstadion website. If a concert is sold out, there generally won't be a box office.

gates.summary: A valid ticket is needed to enter any event; check the individual event page for its entrance time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
